The `_`, `**` and `__` versions and example 533 match too. **Cause:** Before lexing, `inlineTokens` makes a masked copy of the line that the emphasis and strikethrough code read. Every reference link whose ref is defined gets replaced there by `[aaaa…]`. Later the tokenizer rejects a reference link whose text holds another link, because links can't nest. The text is then re-read as plain text, but the masked copy kept the whole span hidden. So the emphasis code couldn't see the `*` inside it, and the closing `]` looked like a letter, which stopped delimiters next to it from closing. **Fix (`src/Lexer.ts`):** - I moved the masking code into a private helper, `maskInline(src)`. It works exactly as before. - When a reference link is rejected, the lexer now re-masks its label and the trailing `][ref]` from the original text and writes them back into the masked copy. Emphasis inside the text can then pair up.
